new.name: CVE-2026-58192

new.name: CVE-2026-61725

Real decompress_file 0.21.0 vs 0.21.1: escapes on vuln, safe_join rejects on fixed (ef760b6).

new.name: CVE-2026-63341

new.name: CVE-2026-115565

new.name: CVE-2026-63386

new.name: CVE-2026-104199

Real broker 0.11.3 vs 0.11.4: SUBACK 0x00+freeze on vuln, 0x80+responsive on fixed.
